name: Buzzmark
summary: Reads your website, then writes, plans, schedules and measures social posts in that voice, after a 7-day free trial.
description: Buzzmark is an AI social ghostwriter and scheduler for founders and growing businesses. It learns a voice from the company website, then writes, plans, schedules, publishes and measures posts (a “Buzz” is one new piece it writes). Official pricing: 7 days free, then plans at €29, €49 and €99 a month excluding VAT. The pricing page also describes a limited launch offer: monthly launch prices of €36.75 and €74.25 for the first 12 months, then €49 and €99; yearly first year €294 or €594 (half of twelve months), then the regular yearly rate. The official organization is Piik Labs AB in Göteborg, Sweden. It is not the email service at buzzmarkapp.com or the advertising company at buzzmark.com.
